findings: Non-blocking: acquisition_identity.expected_binding_matches is recorded in the receipt but does not gate the final VERIFIED status; a mismatched identity.json still yields status=VERIFIED. The hard-coded SIZE/MD5 pins are what actually gate copying, so this is a provenance-visibility issue only — downstream consumers of the receipt must check the binding field explicitly.

Non-blocking: receipt drive_candidates contains full discovered paths of any train.7z under MyDrive/Shareddrives, and the poll worker prints the receipt; the poll prompt inaccurately calls receipt contents 'fixed paths'. Exposure is limited to the operator's own Drive folder names and stays in 0600 private logs.

Non-blocking: orchestrator records actual_models from the worker result but does not enforce the requested model; enforcement relies on the --model flag. Acceptable since exact cell-source verification, not worker-model identity, is the effective execution boundary.

Non-blocking: verify_poll's canonical=rstrip('\n') tolerates multiple trailing newlines, slightly broader than the documented 'terminal LF only'; trailing newlines cannot alter executed Python semantics.

Non-blocking: scripts run() swallows BaseException and exits 0 on failure; recovery correctly depends on the receipt's BLOCKED_OR_FAILED status, and the orchestrator never reads the background process exit code.

Verified fail-closed boundaries: CPU-only Colab gate (COLAB_RELEASE_TAG present, nvidia-smi absent), Drive mount assertions in every cell that touches Drive, exclusive destinations (open('xb'), mkdir(mode=0o700)), incomplete Drive scan aborts before any copy, fresh copy fully re-hashed against pinned MD5 with source stability check (st_ino/size/mtime_ns), capacity check honestly labeled as non-authoritative.

Verified approval preservation: reviewed() enforces APPROVE verdict, scope, commit match, Fable reviewer model, response-file sha256, and current hashes of all three reviewed files, so approval goes stale on any file change.

Verified poll authority limits: poll cells only assert verify.py hash, read receipt.json, and run metadata-only observe(); verify_poll rejects unexpected notebook operations, requires includeOutputs=False, enforces read-back-after-write ordering, forbids cell mutation after first execution, byte-matches executed cells to expected sources up to trailing LF, and the job path is regex-pinned and repr-embedded (no injection).

Verified privacy of persistent artifacts: receipt carries only paths, sizes, checksums, timestamps, whitelisted status strings, and integer PIDs/counters; exception tracebacks go only to the private console.log which no cell reads; orchestrator protocol/stderr/status files are 0600 in the private directory.
